responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exposes the declaration-building services implemented by m2decl.cc. It defines the foreign interface for creating known variables and constants, parameters, functions, module constructors, string and numeric literal trees, type-related string pointers, and target bit-size queries, so Modula-2 frontend code can manufacture GCC DECL nodes through stable entry points.
same_name_distinction: This file is the Modula-2-side declaration module for m2decl services, exposing procedures for creating variables, constants, parameters, functions, constructors, and literals to Modula-2 code. Unlike m2decl.h it is not the native C header, and unlike m2decl.cc it performs no DECL construction itself.
